newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS - T-bond vols soft, April expires quietly.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - T-bond vols soft, April expires quietly.

text.p: Implied volatilities for U.S. Treasury bond options softened as underlying bond prices hovered in narrow ranges, dealers said.
"A lot of people taking positions have already done so and they're just waiting for the Tuesday meeting (of the Federal Open Market Committee)," said a brokerage trader at the Chicago Board of Trade.
April T-bond futures options on the CBOT expired without causing noticeable turbulence as June futures drifted between the 108 and 109 strikes, the center of open-interest concentration.
